==Biography==
===2015 Preseason===
On October 21, 2014 it was announced that Vasilii had decided to leave LMQ along with ackerman and NoName, and that negotiations were ongoing with Mor.<ref>[http://www.ongamers.com/articles/lmq-announces-departure-of-vasilii-ackerman-noname/1100-2279/ LMQ announces departure of Vasilii, ackerman, NoName; negotiations ongoing with Mor] ''ongamers.com''</ref> Vasilii revealed that his decision to leave was based on the financial needs of his family.<ref>[http://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/2k0b92/lmq_vasilii_quit_for_family_problems/ Reddit Post] ''reddit.com''</ref>

On December 3, Vasilii joined [[Vici Gaming]].<ref>[http://p.t.qq.com/longweibo/index.php?lid=2413605127269594324 VG's Weibo post (Chinese)] ''p.t.qq.com'' ([http://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/2o56nn/vici_gaming_vg_signs_fomer_lmqs_adc_vasilii/ English] ''reddit.com'')</ref>

== Trivia ==
* His Chinese ID "死亡宣告" is  the Chinese name of {{ci|Thresh}}'s Death Sentence.
* His English ID "Vasilii" is after [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vasily_Zaitsev_(sniper) Vasily Zaytsev], a famous Soviet Sniper during WWII. Who sniped 225 enemy soldiers in one month during Battle of Stalingrad. He wants to be a good marksman just like this sniper.
* He is friends with [[Doublelift]] and [[Imaqtpie]].
* Known for his {{ci|Tristana}} pocket pick.
* Known for his muscles. 
* Popularized the term LOMO. The origin of LOMO is that Vasilii kept using LOMO as Lmao for unknown reason in NA solo queue games, soon it became a meme in the community.
* He is approximately 192cm (6'4") tall.
* Received a 20 competitive month ban (until the start of split 1 in January 2020) for extreme misconduct.<ref>[https://www.lolesports.com/en_US/articles/competitive-ruling-li-vasilii-wei-jun Competitive Ruling: Li "Vasilii" Wei Jun] ''lolesports.com''</ref>
